info.title: P4TG REST-API
info.description: Documentation of the REST-API of P4TG. Developed by Steffen Lindner (steffen@steffen-lindner.net) and Fabian Ihle (fabian.ihle@uni-tuebingen.de).

get.summary:
Method called on GET /histogram
Returns the histogram configuration of all RX ports.
Ports are front panel numbers with a channel map, like all other endpoints.

200.description: Returns the histogram configuration of all RX ports.

get.summary:
Online endpoint
Returns the currently configured ports

Example 1.summary: Configure front panel port 2, channel 0 with 100G, no FEC, and auto negotiation.

400.description: Invalid port, channel layout, or FEC configuration.

500.description: The switch rejected the port update.

get.summary: Returns the hardware QSFP information reported by the platform module.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: Front-panel module number. If omitted, the module overview is returned.

200.description: Returns a QSFP module overview or detailed information for one module.

400.description: The requested front-panel port or channel is invalid.

503.description: The bf_switchd CLI or QSFP platform command is unavailable.

200.description: Returns a PDF report with P4TG statistics and RFC2544 results when available.
Restarts the currently running traffic generation.

400.description: No traffic generation is running that could be restarted.

get.summary: Returns the current statistics such as traffic rates, frame types, etc.
Returns the content of the P4 tables

200.description: Returns the content of various P4 tables.

get.summary: Returns the current statistics over time with one data point per second.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reduce each series to at most *limit* data points, evenly spaced across the whole test. The first data point is always kept, and the last one whenever *limit* > 1.

get.summary:
Method called on GET /trafficgen
Returns the currently configured traffic generation

200.description: Returns the currently configured traffic generation.

202.description: Returned when no traffic generation is configured.

post.summary:
Method called on POST /trafficgen
Starts the traffic generation with the specified settings in the POST body

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: If set to true, only the current test will be skipped.

200.description: Stops the currently running traffic generation.

Encapsulation.description:
Describes the supported encapsulations of P4TG.
Currently, MPLS, VLAN, QinQ, and SRv6 are supported.

[Encapsulation::None] corresponds to plain Ethernet | IP packet.

burst_packets.description:
Meter burst size in packets for every interval of this pattern. Valid values
are 1 through 1000. When omitted, P4TG calculates a burst per interval from a
preferred 100-packet capacity, its target rate and duration, and the packet
generator's hardware burst size. A supplied value overrides every interval;
values below the hardware burst can reduce the achieved rate, while large
values can blur pattern transitions.

fc_quiet_until.description:
Flash-crowd specific setting: time in nanoseconds within the period
until the quiet phase ends.

fc_ramp_until.description:
Flash-crowd specific setting: time in nanoseconds within the period
until the ramp phase ends.

inverted.description:
Inverts supported patterns. For square waves, the period starts in the low phase.
For sawtooth, the period starts high and decreases linearly.

sample_rate.description: The number of samples per period.

square_high_until.description: Time spent in the high phase for square waves in the range of [0, period]

square_low.description: The minimum value for a square wave in the range of [0,1]

GenerationUnit.description: Describes the unit for a generated traffic stream

count.description: Number of packets in this bin.

probability.description: Probability for this bin based on total_pkt_count.

percentiles.description: Percentiles to calculate from histogram data. Float values between 0 and 1.0

oneOf.description:
Optional stream grouping for this histogram. Missing or empty groups
retain the legacy wildcard match over every application ID.

data_bins.description: HashMap with bin index as key and bin count with probability as value.

mean.description: Mean calculated from the histogram data.

missed_bin_count.description: Number of packets not matched to any bin.

percentiles.description: HashMap with percentiles and their values.

std_dev.description: Standard deviation calculated from the histogram data.

total_pkt_count.description: Total number of packets matched to bins.

aggregate.description:
Application IDs collected into one logical aggregate. The controller
uses the minimum number of ternary masks required to cover this set.

separate.description: Application IDs collected with exact matches and exposed separately.

mae.description:
Mean absolute error. Only calculated if sample mode is false.
This value is directly calculated in the data plane.

mean.description:
Mean value. Either based on samples or computed in the data plane.
See sample mode.

n.description: Number of IAT samples. Only valid if sample mode is true.

std.description: Standard deviation. Only calculated if sample mode is true.

ip_dst_mask.description:
Mask that is used to randomize the IP dst address.
255.255.255.255 means that all bytes in the IP address are randomized.

ip_src_mask.description:
Mask that is used to randomize the IP src address.
255.255.255.255 means that all bytes in the IP address are randomized.

ipv6_dst_mask.description:
Mask that is used to randomize the IP dst address. The 48 least-significant bits can be randomized.
::ff:ffff:ffff means that the 48 least significant bits in the IP address are randomized.

ipv6_src_mask.description:
Mask that is used to randomize the IP src address. The 48 least-significant bits can be randomized.
::ff:ffff:ffff means that the 48 least significant bits in the IP address are randomized.

bos.description: Bottom-of-stack bit of this MPLS LSE

tc.description: Traffic class field of this MPLS LSE

connected_clients.description:
Number of other GUI clients that polled this endpoint recently, i.e.
concurrent web sessions (excluding the requester's own session).

PortResponse.description: OpenAPI representation of the `rbfrt::util::Port` returned by `GET /ports`.

command.description: Command executed inside the platform QSFP uCLI node.

output.description: Text produced by the platform-specific QSFP command.

RangeCountValue.description:
Stores the number of packets that have been received with frame size
in a given range

high.description: upper bound on the frame size

low.description: lower bound on the frame size

packets.description: number of packets with lower bound <= packet size <= upper bound

frame_sizes.description: Fixed Ethernet frame sizes; zero selects the non-standard IMIX ZLT profile.

RxMappingMode.description: Selects how expected RX ports are assigned to generated traffic.

app_l2_frame_sizes.description: Number of L2 bytes counted per generated frame, keyed by application ID.

app_rx_l2.description:
L2 receive rate per stream and port.
The number corresponds to the app_id in the Stream description.

app_tx_l2.description:
L2 send rate per stream and port.
The number corresponds to the app_id in the Stream description.

elapsed_time.description: Elapsed time since the traffic generation has started in seconds.

frame_size.description: Frame size statistics that are divided in (lower, upper) sections.

frame_type_data.description: Statistics what kind of packets have been received per port

iat_histogram.description: IAT histogram data per port and per bin.

iats.description: Statistics of the inter arrival times per port.

out_of_order.description: Number of out of order packets per port.

packet_loss.description: Number of lost packets per port.

rtt_histogram.description: RTT histogram data per port and per bin.

rtts.description: Statistics of the round trip times per port.

sample_mode.description:
Indicates whether the sample mode is used or not.
In sampling mode, IATs are sampled and not calculated in the data plane.
It is recommended to don't use the sample mode to get more precise values

app_id.description:
Application id number. This number is used to configure the traffic generator.
App ids 1-7 are possible for streams.

batches.description: Sends more bursty traffic resulting in a more accurate rate

burst.description: Maximal allowed burst (= packets). Burst = 1 is used for IAT precision mode, Burst = 100 for Rate precision.

detnet_cw.description: d-CW of DetNet, with sequence numbers based on RFC 8964

oneOf.description: Length of Sequence numbers in the d-CW. 8, 16, or 28.

frame_size.description: L2 frame size of the stream.

generation_accuracy.description: These values are set by P4TG when the stream is generated to indicate the applied configuration.

gtpu.description: Flag that indicates if traffic should be encapsulation in GTP-U

ip_version.description: Determines the IP version, either v4 or v6. Option to make it backward compatible

mna_post_stack.description:
Flag that indicates the MPLS stack contains post-stack data (MNA PSD).
When set, TX timestamp is written on the TX recirc pass because the
final-TX-port parser cannot reach hdr.path past the PSMHT.

n_packets.description:
These values are set by P4TG when the stream is generated to indicate the applied configuration.
Overall number of packets that are generated for this stream per `timeout` ns, i.e., over all
`n_pipes` pipes and including all batches of a burst. Values provided by the client are ignored.

n_pipes.description: These values are set by P4TG when the stream is generated to indicate the applied configuration.

number_of_lse.description: Number of MPLS LSEs in this stream. The value has to equal the length of the MPLS stack in a stream setting.

number_of_srv6_sids.description:
Number of SIDs in SRv6 header. At maximum 4 can be used.
A flag to indicate if there is another IP tunnel following the SRv6 headers

oneOf.description: Traffic shaping pattern applied to this stream

stream_id.description:
Identifies the stream. The same value is used in stream settings to
configure that stream for an individual port

timeout.description:
These values are set by P4TG when the stream is generated to indicate the applied configuration.
Time between two packet generator timer expirations in ns. Includes the batch factor.

traffic_rate.description: Traffic rate in Gbps that should be generated.

oneOf.description: Unit for stream generation, e.g., Gbps, Mbps, Mpps

vxlan.description: Flag that indicates if traffic should be encapsulation in VxLAN

active.description: Indicates if this stream setting is active.

channel.description: Channel of the egress port to which the stream should be sent

mpls_stack.description: An MPLS stack to be combined with Encapsulation = MPLS. The length of the MPLS stack has to equal the number_of_lse parameter in each Stream.

port.description: Egress port to which the stream should be sent.

oneOf.description: Expected receive port for this stream/TX pair in per-stream mapping mode.

stream_id.description: ID of the stream. This stream_id maps to the stream_id in the Stream description.

app_rx_l2.description: L2 receive rates per port, application ID, and time

app_tx_l2.description: L2 send rates per port, application ID, and time

name.description: Name of the test those stats belong to

out_of_order.description: Number of out-of-order packets per test and port

packet_loss.description: Number of lost packets per test and port

rtt.description: RTT values per test and port

rx_rate_l1.description: L1 receive rates per test and port

tx_rate_l1.description: L1 send rates per test and port

TrafficGenData.description: Represents the body of the GET / POST endpoints of /trafficgen

drain_duration_secs.description:
Time after packet generation is disabled during which the RX measurement
path remains active so in-flight packets can still update statistics.
Limited to [`MAX_DRAIN_DURATION_SECS`].

duration.description: The duration of this test in seconds.

iat_histogram_config.description: Mapping between RX port and IAT histogram config.

mode.description: Generation mode that should be used.

name.description: The name of the test. This is used to identify the test in the UI.

port_tx_rx_mapping.description:
Mapping between TX (send) ports, and RX (receive) ports.
Traffic send on port TX are expected to be received on port RX.
Mapping from TX-front_panel/channel to RX-front-panel/channel

repetitions.description: Number of times this test is executed. RFC2544 uses its own repetition settings.

rtt_histogram_config.description: Mapping between RX port and RTT histogram config.

rx_mapping_mode.description: Selects whether RX targets are configured per TX port or per stream/TX pair.

stream_settings.description:
List of stream settings that should be applied.
This also configures which streams are replicated to which ports.

cooldown.description: True while a multi-test sequence is idle before its next run.

draining.description:
True while packet generation is disabled but the RX measurement path
remains active for in-flight packets.

source_name.description:
Stable name of the source configuration. RFC2544 trial names in
`configuration.name` may change while this value remains constant.

TypeCount.description: Stores the number of packet types that have been sent / received.
